properties.SQL select query: SELECT CategoryID, CategoryName, CAST(Description AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS Description FROM Categories
SELECT SupplierID, CompanyName, ContactName, ContactTitle, Address, City, Region, PostalCode, Country, Phone, Fax, CAST(HomePage AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS HomePage FROM Suppliers
SELECT ShipperID, CompanyName, Phone FROM Shippers

SELECT
  EmployeeID,
  LastName,
  FirstName,
  Title,
  TitleOfCourtesy,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), BirthDate, 23) AS BirthDate,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), HireDate,  23) AS HireDate,
  Address,
  City,
  Region,
  PostalCode,
  Country,
  HomePhone,
  Extension,
  CAST(Notes AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS Notes,
  ReportsTo
FROM Employees
SELECT ProductID, ProductName, SupplierID, CategoryID, QuantityPerUnit, UnitPrice, UnitsInStock, UnitsOnOrder, ReorderLevel, Discontinued FROM Products
SELECT CustomerID, CompanyName, ContactName, ContactTitle, Address, City, Region, PostalCode, Country, Phone, Fax FROM Customers
